17-13-0303-C(1) Tvpe 1 Narrative & Plans — 1215 South Fairfield Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: RM-S Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 2,940 sq, ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to permit a fourth dwelling unit within the
basement of the existing three-story three (3) dwelling unit residential
building for a total of four (4) dwelling units. The height and footprint of
the existing building will remain without change. The subject property is a
Transit Served Location. The proposed residential building will be
supported by three (3) off-street parking spaces at the rear of the subject
property. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative
Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE of the
Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to increase the off-
street parking ratio for a Transit Served Location to 75% (three (3) parking
spaces for four (4) residential units).

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 3,699 square feet (1.26 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 735 square feet per D.U.
(4 residential units)
(C) The amount of off-street parking: 3 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Roosevelt Bus
Route). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to increase the
required number of off-street parking spaces from 2 parking spaces (50%) to 3
parking spaces (75%).

() Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 14 feet-11 inches (existing)
b. Side Setbacks:
North Side: 3 feet (existing)
South Side: 2 feet-4 inches (existing)
c. Rear Setback: 40 feet-1 inches (existing)

{E) Building Height: 34 feet-10 inches (existing)
